chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Moalla ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali from Zurara from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)
Regarding a man who divorced his wife while she was pregnant, can he marry her sister before she gives birth? He (peace be upon him) said: He cannot marry her until her waiting period is completed.
ai.seo_question: Can a man marry his divorced pregnant wife's sister before she gives birth?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the specific duration of the 'iddah (waiting period) for a pregnant woman, which extends until childbirth, thereby prohibiting the marriage of her sister until this period concludes. It reinforces the principle of 'al-jam' bayna al-ukhtayn' (gathering two sisters) by linking the prohibition directly to the completion of the first wife's iddah, a ruling derived from Quranic verse 65:4. This narration is pivotal in Shia jurisprudence for distinguishing between the general iddah of divorce and the extended period applicable to pregnancy.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far

<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who divorced his wife and she was pregnant, can he marry her sister before she places (gives birth)?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He cannot marry her until her term is cleared’.
en.sarwar: 8. Al-Husayn from Muhammad has narrated from Mu’alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali from Zurarah who has said the following:

“About the case of a man who divorces his wife and she is pregnant; if he can marry her sister before she gives birth, he (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘He must not marry her until her time is complete.’”
